headline_seed: Virginia approves redistricting, giving Democrats edge in midterms
description_seed: The new maps in Virginia could make it easier for Democrats to take control of the US House of Representatives in November.

what: Virginia approves redistricting, giving Democrats edge in midterms

clean_source_blocks.text: The new maps in Virginia could make it easier for Democrats to take control of the US House of Representatives in November.
Virginia voters have approved a redistricting measure that could hand Democrats control of the thinly-divided US House of Representatives, US media report.

Tuesday night, Virginia approved a ballot measure to redraw the state’s 11 congressional districts to give Democrats a significant edge — salvaging Democratic hopes of flipping control of the House of Representatives in the fall.
California voters approved their new maps in a special referendum in November, giving Democrats an edge in five new districts.
